title: Congress sends Borland to AARO at the end of March

tellings.quote: So they got me touching Arrow and I went to Arrow. Uh that was the end of March

plain: Dylan Borland is a man who has spoken publicly about UFO matters. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2023, members of Congress put him in touch with AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate unidentified flying objects, and that he went to meet them at the end of March. In his account, it shows lawmakers took what he had to say seriously enough to send him to the government's official UFO office.
